---
name: Card issue
about: Report a wrong, unclear, or broken card (existing solution/instruction/test)
title: ''
labels: card
assignees: ''
---

**Which card?**
File (e.g. `cards/iterators.yaml`) and the card's instruction/question (first line is enough).

**What's wrong?**
- [ ] Solution doesn't compile / fails `clippy`
- [ ] Solution is wrong or a test is missing/incorrect
- [ ] Instruction is ambiguous or not self-contained (see `lint_cards.py`)
- [ ] Typo / formatting / rendering issue
- [ ] Other

Describe the problem clearly enough that a fix can be reviewed against it.

**Suggested fix (optional)**
If you already have a corrected `solution`/`instruction`/`tests` snippet, paste it here.
